description: A contributor's profile by email (exact) or name (substring): canonical name, page hash, totals and per-release counts by role (authored, reviewed, committed, reported, ...), the 5 latest credited commits (commit_sha = the git SHA, roles = every role they had in it), and buildfarm animals they own. People who hid their page are excluded from name lookups. For what they did recently use whats_new. Cite https://pg.ddx.io/community/<hash>.

name.description: :person/canonical-name substring (case-insensitive). Used only when email is not provided.

name: get_contributor
